hotel_name: Hotel O Rohini Sector 20 Formerly Yellow Saffron

positive_snippets: Good hotel and good service for all staff nice stay

Room was good enough and had amenities to stay for 3 hours. I booked this hotel to spend 3 hours only as my ward had an examination centre in nearby area. As a suggestion, the management needs to look into the hiegene being maintained in bathroom. Cumboard and basin require proper cleaning.

It’s a good place especially when you come with your loved one.... People love this place to love each other...

We were here for a few days stay for attending an exam. The atmosphere was serene. No noise. The staffs were helping, well couthed...

There is in-hotel kitchen where they provide food, though at a higher rate. There is a tea shop about 200 metres.
negative_snippets: Very poor quality.. Beds were broken, blanket was stained, toilet seat were broken, tiny space like a matchbox, very impolite, rude behaviour of staff, they keep on arguing everytime we asked for simple utility things.. They were giving normal tap water in water bottle with broken seal. They were nt asking couples for id but with us they want id of our guest also. Such horrible experience.

Better book from make my trip, the receptionist told 1200 rs per night and when I showed makemytrip  he decreased it to 675+190 tax as if in make my trip and asked me to pay 1000 including deposit and will pay back when check out.
But at check out time they told it was told 1000/night . Go with makemytrip. Just telling what happened, no discount when you go direct.
